description: Bannon animation source registry. Maps semantic animation states to source files from permitted/open sources.
notes: Each entry must include: id, file, semantic_state, source_convention (mixamo|fbx|bvh|mocap), license, provenance.
DO NOT add proprietary Tekken animation bytes or non-redistributable Schwarzerblitz character assets.
Bannon repo mocap sources (assets/mocap/open/) take priority.
Mixamo-compatible material is permitted where license allows.
